SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(Player.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player_Attributes
INNER JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
